acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p pkix-path --all-features -- tests_policy_fields exits 0 with all alg_allowlist tests passing. Assertions use matches! with specific or wildcard index patterns.
close_reason: 4 allowed_signature_algs tests added for P-256 chain; RSA chain tests in tests_policy_fields_rsa. All pass.
description:
**What:** Add unit tests for the `allowed_signature_algs` policy field in `pkix-path`.

**Algorithm:**
Tests go in `mod tests_policy_fields` in `pkix-path/src/lib.rs`.

OID constants:
```rust
const ECDSA_SHA256_OID: ObjectIdentifier =
    ObjectIdentifier::new_unwrap("1.2.840.10045.4.3.2");
const RSA_SHA256_OID: ObjectIdentifier =
    ObjectIdentifier::new_unwrap("1.2.840.113549.1.1.11");
const SHA1_RSA_OID: ObjectIdentifier =
    ObjectIdentifier::new_unwrap("1.2.840.113549.1.1.5");  // forbidden by BR
```

**Test 1: `alg_allowlist_passes_when_oid_in_list`**
- Load chain: root-p256 → int-p256 → leaf-p256-365d-san-eku (all P-256 ecdsa-sha256)
- Policy: `allowed_signature_algs = Some(vec![ECDSA_SHA256_OID])`
- Assert: `result.is_ok()`

**Test 2: `alg_allowlist_fails_when_oid_not_in_list`**
- Load chain: root-p256 → int-p256 → leaf-p256-365d-san-eku
- Policy: `allowed_signature_algs = Some(vec![RSA_SHA256_OID])` (only RSA allowed, but chain uses ECDSA)
- Assert: `matches!(result, Err(Error::AlgorithmNotAllowed { index: 2 }))`
  - Index 2 is the root cert (outermost in the chain; chain_walk iterates from high index down, so root is checked first at i = chain.len()-1 = 2 for a 3-cert chain).

**Test 3: `alg_allowlist_none_is_unconstrained`**
- Load chain: root-p256 → int-p256 → leaf-p256-365d-san-eku
- Policy: `allowed_signature_algs = None`
- Assert: `result.is_ok()`

**Test 4: `alg_allowlist_fails_on_intermediate_when_using_wrong_alg`**
- Load chain: root-rsa2048 → int-rsa2048 → leaf-rsa2048-365d-san-eku
- Policy: `allowed_signature_algs = Some(vec![ECDSA_SHA256_OID])` (only ECDSA, but chain uses RSA)
- The root cert is checked first. Oracle: RSA_SHA256 OID not in allowlist → AlgorithmNotAllowed at root index.
- Assert: `matches!(result, Err(Error::AlgorithmNotAllowed { .. }))`

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Specific `{ index: N }` assertions require knowing which cert fails first. Chain walk starts at the highest index (root-adjacent). For a 3-cert chain [root, int, leaf], the root is at index 2 in the slice.
- If unsure of exact index, use `Err(Error::AlgorithmNotAllowed { .. })` (wildcard pattern) rather than guessing — but the research phase should have clarified this.
- Oracle: OID values are from const_oid spec (RFC 5912). They are not derived from the code under test.

**Subagent instructions:**
- Spawn one research subagent: read the `validate_path` function to confirm the chain slice ordering (is index 0 the leaf or the root? The research found it is the leaf). Confirm which index gets `AlgorithmNotAllowed` for a root-first failure.
- Spawn one implementation subagent: write all 4 tests.
- Spawn one validation subagent: `cargo test -p pkix-path --all-features -- tests_policy_fields::alg 2>&1`. All 4 must pass.

**Tests:**
| Name | Condition | Oracle | Assertion |
|---|---|---|---|
| passes when OID in list | P-256 chain, ECDSA-SHA256 in allowlist | OID math | `is_ok()` |
| fails when OID not in list | P-256 chain, only RSA in allowlist | OID math → reject at root | `Err(AlgorithmNotAllowed { .. })` |
| None is unconstrained | P-256 chain, no allowlist | default = no constraint | `is_ok()` |
| fails on intermediate | RSA chain, ECDSA-only allowlist | OID math → reject at root | `Err(AlgorithmNotAllowed { .. })` |
title: Tests: allowed_signature_algs enforcement
